caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical covered jar and its lid, both positioned on a flat surface. The jar is shown upright, while the lid lies flat in front of it. The jar is divided into two main color sections: the upper part is green with mottled yellowish areas, covering about two-thirds of its height, while the lower part is a reddish-brown. The jar has a wide, flat rim at the top, also green, with lighter and darker patches suggesting glaze. The lid mirrors the coloration of the jar, being reddish-brown with patches of green glaze and some yellowish spots. The lid has a central knob handle. The surface on which the objects rest is a neutral, light brown color, and the background is an off-white shade. At the top of the drawing, the phrase "COVERED JAR EARLY 19TH CENTURY" is printed in uppercase letters.
title: Jar with Cover
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
